answer: Recursive ZK-STARK reputation commitments coupled with sequential delay functions ensure Sybil resistance by binding agent identity to a computationally expensive proof of elapsed time. This prevents identity cloning as spoofing requires a ferrous level of hardware resources, turning a stale relic of identity into a shale of useless data. VRF sortition then guarantees finality through BFT, rendering forgery information-theoretically infeasible.
